<!-- FITtrack：复制整个 section 可以添加其他项目 -->
<section class="study-section">
  <div class="home-container">

    <div class="study-heading">
      <h2>FITtrack</h2>
      <span class="study-status">Active</span>
    </div>

    <div class="study-description">
      <p>
        FITtrack explores the challenges people in rural Louisiana may
        face when completing an at-home colorectal cancer screening test.
        Through brief text-message check-ins, we learn where participants
        are in the screening process and what may be making it difficult
        to take the next step.
      </p>

      <p>
        What we learn helps us develop more timely and personalized support
        throughout the screening process—from getting a test kit, to
        completing and returning it, to understanding the results.
      </p>
    </div>

    <p class="study-focus">
      <strong>Focus:</strong>
      Colorectal cancer screening · Text messaging · Personalized support
    </p>


    <!-- 点击展开：参与者可以获得什么 -->
    <details class="study-accordion">
      <summary>What we will provide?</summary>

      <div class="study-accordion-body">
        <p>
          Participants may receive a free at-home screening kit,
          text-based navigation support, and up to $65 in compensation
          for completing study activities.
        </p>
      </div>
    </details>


    <!-- 点击展开：参与条件 -->
    <details class="study-accordion">
      <summary>Who may be eligible?</summary>

      <div class="study-accordion-body">
        <p>You may be eligible if you:</p>

        <ul>
          <li>
            Live in a suburban or rural area of Louisiana, based on ZIP
            code and HRSA rural-area definitions, and do not consider
            yourself an urban resident
          </li>

          <li>Are 45–75 years old</li>

          <li>
            Do not have a personal history of colorectal cancer or
            certain types of colorectal polyps
          </li>

          <li>
            Are not currently up to date with colorectal cancer screening,
            including:
            <ul>
              <li>
                stool-based testing such as gFOBT, FIT, or FIT-DNA
                within the past year
              </li>
              <li>flexible sigmoidoscopy within the past 5 years</li>
              <li>CT colonography within the past 5 years</li>
              <li>colonoscopy within the past 10 years</li>
            </ul>
          </li>

          <li>Speak English</li>

          <li>
            Have access to a cell phone or smartphone that can send
            and receive text messages
          </li>
        </ul>

        <p>
          <strong>Note:</strong>
          This study requires U.S. citizenship and Social Security
          number verification.
        </p>
      </div>
    </details>


    <!-- 参与方式 -->
